ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Data Stealing Via Chromium Headless Debugging
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects chromium based browsers starting in headless and debugging mode and pointing to a user profile. This could be a sign of data stealing or remote control

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-remote\\-debugging\\-.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-user\\-data\\-dir.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-headless.*"))
